Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Neither Rahi nor his friends ____ qualified for the job.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) has
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) is
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) are
Daily Quiz.exp:
Neither .... nor দ্বারা দুইটা Noun/Pronoun যুক্ত হলে শেষেরটা অনুযায়ী verb বসে। যেহেতু শেষের অংশে his friends – Plural Noun আছে, তাই এখানে ‍are হবে।
আর বাক্যটি Passive ধারণা দিচ্ছে, তাই এখানে had বসালে sentence টি structure-গত দিক থেকে ভুল হবে।

• [Either/neither] + noun + [or/nor] + singular noun + singular verb.
- Neither the salesmen nor the marketing manager is in favor of the system.

• [Either/neither] + noun + [or/nor] + plural noun + plural verb.
- Neither Rahi nor his friends are qualified for the job.

• Either and neither are singular if they are not used with or and nor.
- If either of you takes a vacation now, we will not be able to finish the work.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Choose the correct sentence:
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Each boy and each girl in this class wins a prize.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Each boy and each girl in this class win a prize.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Each boy and each girl in this class have won a prize.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Each boys and each girls in this class has won a prize.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Each/ every যুক্ত দুইটি Noun/ Pronoun যদি and দিয়ে যুক্ত হয় তবুও Verb Singular ই বসে।
কারণ এগুলো হচ্ছে distributive pronoun যা প্রত্যেককে আলাদা করে বুঝায়।
তাই, এখানে verb এর সাথে 's' যুক্ত হবে। 
সুতরাং, সঠিক বাক্য হবে - ক) Each boy and each girl in this class wins a prize.

ঘ) অপশনে each boys and each girls লিখা হয়েছে যা ভুল। Distributive adjective এর পর noun/proun - singular বসাতে হবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Find out the correct sentence.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The number of examinees in the present situation are noteworthy.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) A number of boys was flying kites.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The number of students was fifty nine.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) A number of problems prevails on his way to success.
Daily Quiz.exp:
• The number of এর পরে Noun- Plural হলেও Verb Singular হয়। কারণ এখানে Head-word হচ্ছে number যা singular.
- The number of students was fifty nine.
- The number of examinees in the present situation is noteworthy.

• A number of এর পরে Noun ও Verb দুইটাই Plural হয়। কারণ a number of একটি Plural Determiner যার অর্থ হচ্ছে কিছু সংখ্যক। এবং এর পরের Noun টি Head-word হয় এবং সে অনুযায়ী Verb বসে।
- A number of boys were flying kites.
- A number of problems prevail on his way to success.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Kuber _____ absent for a week.

Daily Quiz.option2: খ) has been being
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) was
Daily Quiz.exp:
for a week – Period of Time থাকায় বুঝা যায় এটা Perfect Continuous Tense হবে।
কিন্তু মূল verb – ‘be’ verb হলে সেক্ষেত্রে Perfect Tense হয়, Perfect Continuous Tense হয় না।
তাই শূন্যস্থানে has been বসবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Choose the correct sentence:
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Rishan walks as if he is lame.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Rishan walks as if he had been lame.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Rishan walks as if he has lame.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Rishan walks as if he were lame.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Present + as if/as though + Past Indefinite
আর as if/as though + Past Indefinite এ ‘be’ verb আসলে তা সব সময় were হবে।
সে অনুসারে সঠিক বাক্য - Rishan walks as if he were lame.

উল্লেখ্য
Past Indefinite + as if/as though + Past Perfect. 
যেমন: Rishan walked as if he had been lame.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Fill in the blank with correct option: ___________ I would have gone to the station.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) If I know you were coming,
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) If I knew you were coming,
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) If I had known you were coming,
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) If I have known you were coming,
Daily Quiz.exp:
Structure of conditional sentence:
• Zero Conditional = If + Present + Present (shows scientific and general truth)
• 1st Conditional = If + Present + Future
• 2nd Conditional = If + Past Simple + Future in Past (S + would/might/could + Base Form of the Verb)
• 3rd Conditional = If + Past Perfect (had +V3) + Perfect Modal (S + would have/could have/might have + V3)

Sentence টি Perfect conditional/ 3rd conditional.
পরের অংশে যেহেতু would have gone দেয়া আছে তাই আগের অংশে If clause- এ had + V3 হবে।
অর্থাৎ, প্রথম অংশে - If I had known you were coming বসবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Choose the correct sentence:
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He was mistaken to think so.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I succeeded to solve the problem.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) None should indulge to gamble.

Cor: None should indulge in gambling.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Which sentence is the correct one?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I insisted on his leaving the job but he persisted in it.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I insisted in his leaving the job but he persisted in it.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I insisted on his leaving the job but he persisted on it.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I insisted on his leaving the job but he persisted for it.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Insist on/upon - কোনো কিছুতে জোর দেয়া।
Insist on/upon এর সাথে verb এর ing form বসে।

Persist in something/in doing something - যুক্তি, ব্যর্থতা বা বিরোধিতা সত্ত্বেও কোনো বিষয়ে নিজস্ব অভিমত বজায় রাখা; নাছোড়বান্দার মতো অটল থাকা।

সে অনুসারে correct senetence: ক) I insisted on his leaving the job but he persisted in it.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Which is the incorrect one?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He went for a rest.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I have caught a cold.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I have great deal of work in hand.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The vacation came to a close.

এখানে rest, cold, great deal of, close সবগুলোর পূর্বে a বসবে।
গ) অপশনে যেহেতু great deal of এর পূর্বে a নেই তাই এটি incorrect.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Choose the correct option -
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The Titanic went down with his crew.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The baby is crying for its mother.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The mother rose in her and she led her to take the little baby in her lap.
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Neuter Gender Singular হলে সেক্ষেত্রে it, এবং Plural হলে they বসে।
ছোট শিশুকেও Neuter Gender এর মত ব্যবহার করা হয়, কারণ অচেতন পদার্থের মত শিশুরও বোধশক্তি নেই।
যেমন - The baby is crying for its mother.

• তবে Neuter Gender হলেও দেশ, নদী, জাহাজ ইত্যাদির ক্ষেত্রে Feminine Gender (She) ব্যবহৃত হয় - The Titanic went down with her crew.

• Common Noun (যেমন - Mother, King ইত্যাদি) যদি Abstract Noun হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়, তখন এটা neuter gender হিসেবে গণ্য হয়।
যেমন - The mother rose in her and it led her to take the little baby in her lap.
এখানে Mother বলতে মাতৃত্ব বুঝাচ্ছে, মা নয়। তাই এর পরিবর্তে Pronoun – it বসবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Which one is the correct sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) A black and white cow are grazing in the field.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) A black and a white cow are grazing in the field.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) A black and a white cow has grazed in the field.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) A black and white cow have grazed in the field.
Daily Quiz.exp:
দুই বা ততোধিক Noun ভিন্ন ভিন্ন ব্যক্তি, প্রাণি বা বস্তুকে বোঝালে প্রতিটি Noun এর পূর্বে Article বসে।
তবে একই ব্যক্তি, প্রাণি বা বস্তুকে বোঝালে শুধু প্রথম Noun এর পূর্বে Article বসে।

অর্থাৎ, A black and white cow বললে বুঝাবে একটি সাদা-কালো রং মিশ্রিত গরু। অর্থাৎ, গরুর সংখ্যা একটি, তাই verb singular হবে।
এবং A black and a white cow বললে বুঝাবে একটি সাদা এবং একটি কালো গরু। অর্থাৎ, গরুর সংখ্যা দুইটি। তাই verb plural হবে। 

তাই সঠিক উত্তর হবে খ) A black and a white cow are grazing in the field.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Sabit look forward to _______ a guitar.

Daily Quiz.option2: খ) have played
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) be played

Sabit is look forward to playing a guitar.
